kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتهب (form VIII)
# أَنْتَهِبُ (ʔantahibu) /ʔan.ta.hi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# أُنْتَهَبُ (ʔuntahabu) /ʔun.ta.ha.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# أَنْتَهِبَ (ʔantahiba) /ʔan.ta.hi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# أُنْتَهَبَ (ʔuntahaba) /ʔun.ta.ha
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
